title: Graphic Chiaroscuro
description: Illustration numérique à fort contraste fusionnant l'esthétique des comics pulp des années 80 avec un rendu lisse à l'aérographe. Définie par un éclairage directionnel dur, des ombres noires pures et écrasantes, et des arrière-plans unis hyper-saturés créant une intensité saisissante de type affiche.
description_en: High-contrast digital illustration merging 1980s pulp comic aesthetics with smooth, airbrushed rendering. Defined by harsh directional lighting, crushing pure black shadows, and hyper-saturated solid backgrounds that create a stark, poster-like intensity.
description_fr: Illustration numérique à fort contraste fusionnant l'esthétique des comics pulp des années 80 avec un rendu lisse à l'aérographe. prompt: High-contrast graphic digital illustration, blending 1980s pulp comic cover art with smooth airbrushed 3D rendering. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, no canvas edges, full bleed to all four corners. The rendering technique relies on intense, theatrical chiaroscuro, where subjects are illuminated by harsh, directional key lights and stark rim lights. Surfaces in the light exhibit smooth, polished gradients and hyper-rendered volumes without visible brushstrokes, instantly transitioning into deep, crushing, pure black (#000000) shadows. These absolute black shadow shapes act as structural linework, defining contours and anatomy with razor-sharp, hard-edged precision. The color palette is fiercely restricted and aggressive, featuring a blazing, ultra-saturated {{primary_color}} as the dominant tone, accented by intense {{accent_color}} highlights and {{secondary_color}} midtones. The background is a stark, flat, textureless void, pushing the subject forward into extreme, shallow-depth graphic relief. Edges are exceptionally crisp, cutting sharp silhouettes against the saturated backdrop. The atmosphere is cinematic, aggressive, and highly stylized, reminiscent of premium graphic novel covers. Textures are minimal, favoring sleek finishes in the highlights and flat matte voids in the darks, unified by a microscopic film grain. graphic illustration, pulp comic, chiaroscuro, harsh lighting, pure black shadows, airbrushed gradients, high contrast, dramatic shadows, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Subjects move with deliberate, cinematic weight, striking dynamic, poster-like poses that lock into place. Shadow shapes morph aggressively across surfaces as objects rotate through the harsh directional lighting.
video.camera: The camera utilizes slow, dramatic push-ins or stark, locked-off low angles, maintaining a rigid, graphic composition.
video.temporal_texture: The smooth gradients and deep black shadow boundaries remain perfectly crisp and stable, while a subtle, uniform film grain shimmers evenly across the frame.
video.avoid: Avoid motion blur, soft shadow transitions, realistic ambient occlusion, or erratic, handheld camera shaking that breaks the polished graphic aesthetic.
